feature: Basic lands in the draft diff
note: Three surfaces, one deck. The defect was an ABSENCE — a draft that cut five Swamps and added five other lands drew no row on the review page and named no card in the banner — so the artefact that shows the fix is a photograph of the rows now being there, at both widths, on every surface that draws a diff. The version rail is the third row for the same reason it is named in the plan: `loadVersionDiff` never filtered basics, so it has been drawing `Swamp 5 → 0` correctly the whole time, and the sheet is what shows the draft's own page finally agreeing with it. `BASICS_DRAFT_DECK` comes from the environment, so no account's deck id lives here; point it at a committed deck whose draft has moved a basic land, which `pnpm probe:review` builds and tears down and `scripts/probe-review-changes.mjs` documents. No `shares` block: the review row and the rail row are deliberately different components, because one carries availability and a control and the other is a historical record with neither.
